title: Formalize rectangular decoder rank and minor cost interfaces in Lean
body:
Completes item 5 of [DreamingOfClouds’s explicit Lean handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18934590). The predecessor formally exposes the diagonal-output case; this package exposes the general rectangular rank-to-cost bound needed by the generic-rank and jet arguments, plus a nonzero-minor cost bridge.

For fields F→K and supported row/column weights, Lean proves
`rank_K(Σ diag(p_t) map(B) diag(q_t)) ≤ Σ rank_F B[S_t,U_t]`, its entrywise Hadamard form, and the lower bound on that same original-field cost from any nonzero selected square minor. A characteristic-two specialization preserves the binary block ranks. Explicit expanded type contracts expose every hypothesis. No output-diagonal, unit-diagonal, admissibility or selector-injectivity assumptions are added.

This composes **DreamingOfClouds’s existing helper proofs**, vendored unchanged from PR2162 head `113a718265c62aec301c5695f4bfb9c421bef7ab`, with the original notice and license. It completes a requested formal interface; the mathematical rank argument was already stated in that predecessor.

Validation:

- Fresh Lean 4.33.0-rc1 builds passed in both existing-cache and fresh dependency-fetch modes, with identical receipts. All four local modules rebuilt against pinned Mathlib 55b7917b472489c7c56a0fa6393af05cfd536599; all nine dependency heads checked.
- All 18 requested axiom reports contain only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. Rectangular rational-function-field and empty-family examples pass; three invalid proofs omitting support/minor hypotheses receive real Lean type errors.
- Independent finite arithmetic passed 196,608 cases over binary and four-element fields, including two-term cancellation and characteristic-change counterexamples.
- Registered CPython3.12.3 replay and eight failure-control groups pass. Both commands pass under optimized CPython3.14.4 in a read-only, Git-free export, with 18 files unchanged. Patch applies cleanly to current main.

The default verifier explicitly reports `kernel_checked=false`; a dedicated scoped workflow performs the checksum-pinned Lean build. The package README gives both reproduction commands and the exact theorem statements. Mathlib uses its official cache; this did not rebuild all of Mathlib from source.

Scope: `research/lean-decoder-rank-interface/` and its dedicated workflow only. The specific jet/valuation rank witness, anti-Fano theorem, T=3 conjecture and full multiplication/supplier admission remain outside this proof. No selected-frontier or κ change.

[Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2254). Base 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority 4, original random nonce d8d89da538eb6248543c95377394d893; scoped handoff refinement without rerolling. Final overlap covered490 open PRs and973 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; all 6 targeted matches reviewed. Gareth Davidson/@bitplane with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents or independent human review.

Exact contribution head: `f7e8e8a3ff8a889366f97e222eef262d61312b58`.
